description: Mobile screenshot of a verified KUTV 2News Facebook post reporting 14 confirmed fire spots set between 1-5 a.m. Saturday in the Manti-La Sal National Forest, quoting the U.S. Forest Service that the fires were intentionally set arson, with a link to the KUTV story. Below the text are two photos of burned/charred pine trees and forest floor, one with orange flagging tape.
text: 12:48. KUTV 2News. KUTV 2News. 1d. ARSON: Right now, there are 14 confirmed fire spots, all started between 1-5 a.m. Saturday morning. "These were intentionally set fires, not caused by dragging chains, abandoned campfires, etc." - U.S. Forest Service. STORY: http://kutv.com/news/local/suspected-arson-on-the-manti-la-sal-national-forest. Write a comment...

description: Screenshot of the RAPTOR Public 2D web map (Real-Time Assessment and Planning Tool for Oregon, an Oregon Office of Emergency Management/Esri application) showing the Pacific Northwest — Washington, Oregon, Idaho and western Montana — covered with dozens of red flame icons marking named active wildfire incidents, consistent with the September 2020 fire season. Large fire perimeters (Riverside, Lionshead, Echo Mtn Complex, Almeda Drive, Slater, Two Four Two, Brattain and others) are drawn along the Oregon Cascades and southern Oregon. A sidebar describes the tool and its data layers.
text: RAPTOR Public 2D. About. Legend. Layers. Welcome to the Public 2D Version of RAPTOR (Real-Time Assessment and Planning Tool for Oregon). This map includes information about what is going on currently within our area. Specific elements of information include weather watches and warnings, local storm reports, live weather radar, road closures/delays, and active incidents. Want to see the latest application? description: Screenshot of a verified FBI Portland tweet dated September 11, 2020, stating that reports of extremists setting wildfires in Oregon are untrue and urging people to share only official information. The tweet includes a graphic quote card (1 of 2) attributed to Special Agent in Charge Loren Cannon, FBI Portland Division, saying the FBI investigated several such reports and found them to be untrue.
text: FBI Portland. @FBIPortland. Reports that extremists are setting wildfires in Oregon are untrue. Help us stop the spread of misinformation by only sharing information from trusted, official sources. "FBI Portland and local law enforcement agencies have been receiving reports that extremists are responsible for setting wildfires in Oregon. With our state and local partners, the FBI has investigated several such reports and found them to be untrue. 1 of 2. SPECIAL AGENT IN CHARGE LOREN CANNON. Federal Bureau of Investigation. FBI PORTLAND DIVISION. 12:20 PM · Sep 11, 2020 · Hootsuite Inc.

description: Screenshot of a verified tweet by Fox News correspondent Kevin Corke (@kevincorke), dated September 12, 2020, saying an unnamed DOJ source told him to "set my alarm clock" regarding indictments or arrests, tagged #DurhamReport; Corke adds he will believe it when he sees it. The interface shows Dutch-language elements ("Tweet vertalen", "12 sep.").
text: Kevin Corke. @kevincorke. Remember when I said, wake me when there are indictments and or arrests?  Well, a solid DOJ source just told me to "set my alarm clock." I said, I'll believe it when I see it. #DurhamReport. Tweet vertalen. 12:49 a.m. · 12 sep. 2020 · Twitter Web App
flags: Anonymous-source claim about coming indictments; no indictments materialized from the Durham probe at that time — carried as a claim, not fact
